intro.text: An empire on Ashyn whose conquests were supported by Odium and the power of unrestricted Surges.

items.text: With powers granted by Odium, the empire conquered neighboring city-states.
It invited delegates to a conference and offered membership under an implied threat of further conquest. Makibak and Nale departed rather than join.
Honor supplied its opponents with powers to resist, beginning a prolonged struggle.
The scouring of Ashyn destroyed the empire. Jezrien succeeded Zoral and helped lead the survivors toward Roshar.
